breakdown.description: Sudden expansion causes irreversible mixing and head loss; Bernoulli (lossless) cannot be applied directly across the expansion without including the loss term.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes the Borda–Carnot head loss hL = (V1 – V2)²/(2g) in the energy equation, rather than applying a lossless Bernoulli equation. This matches the ground truth's requirement to account for the irreversible head loss in a sudden expansion.
